body.p: A transfer robot includes a plurality of hands, a plurality of hand drive motors, and an arm. The plurality of hands are capable of holding a transfer target object, and pivot individually around a pivoting axis. The plurality of hand drive motors are arranged in a direction following the pivoting axis, such that a motor axis to which the plurality of hands are each connected becomes concentric with the pivoting axis, and directly drive the plurality of hands, respectively. The arm includes therein the plurality of hand drive motors.
